headline: 夏日金曲與夏奇拉
context: 《衛報》樂評選出 2026 年度夏日金曲，克蒙·佩特拉斯（Kim Petras）的〈Jeep〉獲選為年度最佳單曲之一。同一份專題也趁夏奇拉（Shakira）將在世界盃決賽開唱之際，選出她生涯 20 首最佳歌曲。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The annual rundown of Guardian writers picking their most played tracks of the season goes from club-ready pop to sunny tech house Check out a Spotify playlist of the choices Kim Petras’ greatest song to date is also the best outsider country song in recent memory: if Ethel Cain and Lana Del Rey could ever put the beef behind them and duet, the dusty gutter romance of Jeep is exactly how you’d want it to sound. The song creates a flyover state love story in a strangely effective union of hyperpop and Americana, creating a windswept fantasy of “doing some middle America shit” with your man: Four Loko-fueled hookups, gas station canoodling and screaming along to rage music beneath the stars. The truly audacious thing is the bridge, a whispered and impressionistic slur that feels like Petras is eight drinks deep, doing donuts in her car until everything blurs. It’s total make-believe, but Petras is so good at making you feel her longing that it gets me choked up. When she recently came out at a Charli xcx show to perform Jeep unannounced, it already felt like an anthem. Owen Myers Continue reading...

sources.summary: As the Colombian pop supremo prepares to perform at Sunday’s final, we rate her greatest work, including gossipy takedowns and lycanthropic lyrics Of Shakira’s World Cup anthems, it’s the joyfully ludicrous Waka Waka from the 2010 tournament in South Africa that bangs hardest. Featuring Afro-fusion band Freshlyground, the Colombian superstar redraws preened football superstars such as Ronaldo et al as soldiers on a frontline. Continue reading...

thread_text:
《衛報》樂評選出了 2026 年度夏日金曲，克蒙·佩特拉斯（Kim Petras）的新歌〈Jeep〉被形容是她生涯最好的作品之一。同一份專題也趁夏奇拉（Shakira）即將在世界盃決賽開唱，回顧她生涯 20 首最佳歌曲，2010 年世界盃主題曲〈Waka Waka〉被列為代表作。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 17 日的報導。
threads_text:
《衛報》樂評選出了 2026 年度夏日金曲，克蒙·佩特拉斯（Kim Petras）的新歌〈Jeep〉被寫成她生涯最好的作品之一，融合了 hyperpop 和美式鄉村風格的曲風，被形容成一場「公路愛情故事」。同一份專題也趁夏奇拉（Shakira）即將在世界盃決賽開唱之際，回顧她生涯 20 首最佳歌曲，2010 年南非世界盃的主題曲〈Waka Waka〉被列為她最具代表性的作品之一。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 17 日的報導。
voice_text: 夏天到了，樂評選出今年的夏日金曲。克蒙·佩特拉斯的新歌〈Jeep〉，被形容是她生涯最好的作品之一，融合了電子流行和美式鄉村風格。同一份專題也回顧了夏奇拉的生涯二十大金曲，二〇一〇年世界盃的主題曲〈Waka Waka〉，被列為她最具代表性的一首。
